adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which yields 2 when `user_count === limit` (e.g., 50/50). That makes `showingLast` false on the true last page (`currentPage` would be 1), so the `next` action will advance `offset` to `user_count` and call `group.findMembers()`, which requests `/groups/:name/members.json` with `offset=50` and returns an empty members list (since the server uses `limit(...).offset(offset)`). The diff also adds new pagination logic without any accompanying JS tests, but the pagination math issue is a concrete behavioral defect visible from the changes.
